subject: Post-call recap: budget owner & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@astraldata.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: budget owner & procurement checklist

Hi Samir — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before looping in procurement/finance.

Call highlights:
- Astral Data is evaluating a pilot to accelerate semantic search over product docs (target: 6-8 week POC).
- Important constraints: must run in your VPC, SOC2 evidence required, procurement prefers a single SOW + one-month pilot pricing.
- Success criteria: 30% improvement in query latency for high-volume queries; data retention policy aligned with 6 months.

Action items / asks for you: 
1) Can you confirm the economic/budget owner for this initiative? You mentioned someone on the product org — please share name/email so we can include them in the mutual action plan.
2) Please share the security questionnaire your procurement team uses (if available). We can pre-fill and attach SOC2/report.
3) Proposed next meeting: quick alignment with procurement + the budget owner this week or early next.

What I’m sending now: a short recording of today’s demo and our call notes (attached). I’ll pull together a one-page mutual action plan once you confirm the budget owner and security contact.

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (30MB stub)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Samir Shah <samir@astraldata.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@astraldata.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: budget owner & procurement checklist

Thanks Connor — good recap.

Priya (cc) is the budget owner for this stream and will own procurement coordination. She handles vendor approvals and pilot budgets. Priya, Connor will coordinate next steps on logistics and security.

On the security side, attaching our standard vendor assessment form — it has a few items on data residency, encryption, and SOC statements. We will need a copy of your SOC2 and answers filled into the attached questionnaire.

Attaching: astral_security_questionnaire.pdf

Preferred timeline: procurement would like the initial responses and SOC2 by EOD Thursday so we can vet ahead of our internal vendor committee next Monday. Can you hit that cadence?

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Product, Astral Data
samir@astraldata.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@astraldata.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@astraldata.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: budget owner & procurement checklist

Great — thanks Samir and hi Priya, nice to e-meet you.

Priya: welcome — three quick things to unblock timeline: 
- We can deliver a fill of the vendor questionnaire (I’ll coordinate answers with Dev).
- SOC2 and our security package (summary + auditor letter) are ready; I’m attaching the SOC2_Redwood_v2.pdf now and will also drop a link to a concise one-page security snapshot.
- For procurement cadence: we typically propose a 1-month pilot SOW with an opt-in scale plan; happy to run through numbers in the procurement call.

Proposed plan this week:
1) Today: Connor & Dev fill the vendor questionnaire and return it by EOD Thursday (per Samir).
2) Thu 12pm PT: 30-min procurement alignment with Priya + Samir + Connor + Laura (we can move if that slot doesn't work).
3) After that call: Connor to send a mutual action plan + draft SOW for review; legal redlines expected but we aim to avoid extensive changes for a pilot.

Links: HubSpot deal AST-1427 (internal) — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/AST-1427
Mutual action plan template (internal drive) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MUTUALACTIONPLAN-xyz

Attachments in this reply: SOC2_Redwood_v2.pdf (summary)

If Priya confirms Thu 12pm PT works, I’ll book and send a calendar invite.

—Connor
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: budget owner & procurement checklist

Nice — looping in a few internal notes for Connor: 
- I’ll own the procurement call alongside you; I can present a pilot commercial that protects Astral (short term, cancel any time) and offers a pilot discount (15% off pilot fees) to reduce friction.
- If Priya needs an executive sponsor note, I can draft a short summary to accompany vendor committee materials.
- Dev: please prioritize the questionnaire (Connor said EOD Thurs); call out any non-standard answers so we can prep commercial/legal.

Connor — if you book Thu 12pm and Priya confirms, I’ll draft the pilot pricing slide and sponsor note today so we can attach to the MAP before procurement.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
